# Synthetic fixture for OBS-10: node agent that forwards everything to the gateway.
apiVersion: opentelemetry.io/v1beta1
kind: OpenTelemetryCollector
metadata:
  name: node-agent
spec:
  mode: daemonset
  config:
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc:
      filelog:
        include: [/var/log/pods/*/*/*.log]
      hostmetrics:
        scrapers:
          cpu:
    processors:
      memory_limiter:
        check_interval: 1s
        limit_percentage: 80
      batch:
      filter/host:
        metrics:
          metric:
            - 'name == "system.cpu.time"'
    exporters:
      otlp/gateway:
        endpoint: otel-gateway-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
      debug:
    service:
      pipelines:
        logs:
          receivers: [filelog, otlp]
          processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
          exporters: [otlp/gateway]
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
          exporters: [otlp/gateway, debug]
        metrics:
          receivers: [hostmetrics]
          processors: [memory_limiter, filter/host, batch]
          exporters: [otlp/gateway]

# Synthetic fixture for OBS-10: gateway that drops debug logs and health-check spans.
apiVersion: opentelemetry.io/v1beta1
kind: OpenTelemetryCollector
metadata:
  name: otel-gateway
  namespace: observability
spec:
  mode: deployment
  config:
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocols:
          grpc:
            endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
    processors:
      memory_limiter:
        check_interval: 1s
        limit_percentage: 80
      k8sattributes:
      batch:
      filter/debug-logs:
        error_mode: ignore
        logs:
          log_record:
            - 'severity_number < SEVERITY_NUMBER_INFO'
      filter/health:
        error_mode: ignore
        traces:
          span:
            - 'attributes["url.path"] == "/healthz"'
    exporters:
      otlphttp/backend:
        endpoint: https://otlp.vendor.example.com
      debug:
    service:
      pipelines:
        logs:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [memory_limiter, k8sattributes, filter/debug-logs, batch]
          exporters: [otlphttp/backend]
        logs/debug:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: []
          exporters: [debug]
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [memory_limiter, filter/health, batch]
          exporters: [otlphttp/backend]
        metrics:
          receivers: [otlp]
          processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
          exporters: [otlphttp/backend]

# Synthetic fixture for OBS-10: edge relay in a ConfigMap that forwards all logs to the gateway.
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: edge-relay
data:
  relay.yaml: |
    receivers:
      fluentforward:
        endpoint: 0.0.0.0:8006
    processors:
      batch:
    exporters:
      otlp:
        endpoint: http://otel-gateway:4317
    service:
      pipelines:
        logs:
          receivers: [fluentforward]
          processors: [batch]
          exporters: [otlp]
